summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited, a Canadian holding company, announcing a quarterly dividend of CAD 0.315313 per Series K Preferred Share, payable June 30, 2026 to holders of record June 15, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendations, or special-situation mechanics. It is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. dividend notice, and does not trigger any risk-arb or event-driven analysis.
